definition: to not be working, said of a machine
description: On a sunny green city street with wooden apartment buildings, wind turbines on the roofs, pink flowering trees and a wooden tram, a young man in a blue shirt and cream trousers kneels laughing beside a small white delivery robot on wheels whose lid stands open. Inside it a grey and white cat sits among oranges instead of a delivery. One orange rolls away across the pavement, and the young man sits down on the ground, still laughing.

en.question: What is inside the delivery robot?

de.answer: Eine Katze sitzt zwischen den Orangen.
de.question: Was ist im Lieferroboter?

es.answer: Un gato está sentado entre las naranjas.
es.question: ¿Qué hay dentro del robot de reparto?

fr.answer: Un chat est assis parmi les oranges.
phrases: être à genoux sur le trottoir
fr.question: Qu'y a-t-il dans le robot de livraison ?
